outcome: Mode of delivery (normal vs. cesarean section)
Maternal outcomes (prolonged hospital stay, wound infection, postpartum psychosis)
Neonatal outcomes (NICU admission, meconium aspiration syndrome, low Apgar scores)
cohort: 71 post-dated pregnant women who presented to Lalla Ded Hospital, Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Government Medical College Srinagar, between May 2022 and November 2022.
finding: Post-term pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of cesarean section, prolonged hospital stay, wound infection, postpartum psychosis, NICU admission, meconium aspiration syndrome, and low Apgar scores.
